name: Data360Pipeline
description: This Test Connection validates the access against the Salesforce Data 360 instance and the basic metadata extraction of Data Streams, Calculated Insights and Data Transforms.

steps.name: CheckAccess
steps.description: Validate that we can properly reach the Salesforce Data 360 instance and authenticate with the given credentials.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to connect to Salesforce Data 360 — please validate the Consumer Key, Consumer Secret, and Salesforce Domain.

steps.name: GetPipelines
steps.description: List the Data 360 Data Streams, which are ingested as pipelines.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to fetch Data Streams, please validate that the connected app can read the ssot/data-streams endpoint.

steps.name: GetCalculatedInsights
steps.description: List the Data 360 Calculated Insights, which are ingested as pipelines. Not mandatory: an instance with no Calculated Insight still ingests its Data Streams.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to fetch Calculated Insights. Data Streams will still be ingested.

steps.name: GetDataTransforms
steps.description: List the Data 360 Data Transforms, which are ingested as pipelines and back their run status. Not mandatory: an instance with no Data Transform still ingests its Data Streams.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to fetch Data Transforms. Data Streams will still be ingested.
